card.name: Linking words before lab test names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "in" right after monitoring or assessment nouns, just before a laboratory test or blood count is named. Also "more" or "liver" inside such lab-test phrases.

modes.label: Monitoring of labs
modes.description: "of" after words like monitoring, assessments or determinations, before blood counts or liver tests.
modes.example: Periodic monitoring<< of>> white blood cell counts in patients with collagen

modes.label: Inside lab-test phrases
modes.description: A word within a list of tests or lab parameters, just before the test name completes.
modes.example: Monitor blood counts,<< liver>> function, renal function and ferritin monthly

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like routine, laboratory, labs and lab.
card.plain: It fires on the little word after "monitoring" when a lab test is about to be named.
